'''Grundorsen Maelo''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] trooper of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3636 BBY]] he was stationed on [[Ziost/Legends|Ziost]] when former Sith Emperor [[Tenebrae|Vitiate]] came to the world and possessed many of the Imperials on the planet, turning them into his puppets to murder civilians. Grundorsen Maelo was among those who fell under his control and he was killed during the fighting in [[New Adasta]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
Grundorsen Maelo was added to ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic: Shadow of Revan]]'' in game update 3.2. Killing him is required to obtain an achievement.
